prompt.regla_de_oro: Phase N+1 reads docs/vexarq/current/. It does not read docs/vexarq/preliminary/, even when the preliminary is newer.

directorios.directorio: Output of the model, waiting for human review.
The document the user edited, or that continuo mode promoted after it checked itself. It is the only source for the next phase.
Static board. Update it at the end of each request.

escritura.regla: Create the new preliminary without deleting the current document.
Do not edit a current document to "improve" it during generation. Model corrections go to the preliminary.

In validar mode, the user copies or edits the preliminary and leaves the result in current/. The model may create an empty working current/ only when the user asks for a file ready to edit, and it must start from the preliminary without adding new decisions.
In continuo mode, promotion means copying the checked preliminary to current/ and recording which assumptions traveled with it.
If current/ already exists, do not overwrite it. Write a new preliminary version and ask before replacing the current document.

provenance.etiqueta: CONFIRMED: the user said it, or it is in an approved current document.
REPOSITORY: found in existing code or documentation.
INFERENCE: a conclusion of the model, distinct from a fact.
STANDARD_ASSUMPTION: a gap filled in continuo mode from a library example.
PENDING: a decision is missing and the phase must not pretend it exists.
CONTRADICTION: two current sources do not agree.

actualizacion_del_tablero.regla: When the request ends, copy .ai-vexarq/tracker/project-status.template.html to docs/vexarq/status.html if it does not exist yet.
Update only data-vexarq fields. Do not add panels, a long history, or prompt text.
Link each phase to its current document. If only a preliminary exists, the link text is Preliminary and it points at that file. If neither exists, the state is pending and there is no broken link.
Allowed state tokens: pending, in progress, preliminary, current, blocked, not applicable.
